recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5256; future Condition certainty questions should be handled under later substantive Condition modeling issues, not this historical publication-display defect.
issue_request: FHIR-5256 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core Condition ballot correction asking that http://hl7.org/fhir/valueset-condition-certainty.html display the intended value set instead of a publication tooling error: "OperationOutcome cannot be cast to ValueSet."
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5256. Jira comments record "This is fixed now" on 2015-02-12. The closest implementation evidence is commit da32ced84f5bc2a617e32c0a6158d114e24fb18c, "$5447 - fix valueset expansion," which added source/vscache/http_hl7.org_fhir_vs_condition-certainty.xml containing an expanded Condition/Diagnosis Certainty ValueSet.
additional_context: Later accepted Condition modeling work superseded the old certainty concept. FHIR-3976 resolved to rename Condition.status to clinicalStatus and remove the concept of certainty; commit 1f32e2833bae9fb8cc45636c39142020e353b5c6 marked Condition.certainty and ConditionCertainty as removed. The old source/condition/valueset-condition-certainty.xml and vscache entry were later deleted. Current active Condition source binds Condition.verificationStatus to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/condition-ver-status, and current build URL checks return 404 for valueset-condition-certainty.html and 200 for valueset-condition-ver-status.html.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing or editing the obsolete Condition certainty value set would not fix current FHIR source; the current source already reflects the later verificationStatus model.
